freshnessTaxonomy.ENTRY_FRESH: No outcomes used directly or indirectly in Selector/Entry/candidate design or selection. Reservation and PIT gates also required.
freshnessTaxonomy.EXIT_FRESH: No outcomes used in EXIT architecture/fit/selection. Upstream exposure must be disclosed; this design nevertheless uses globally unexposed new EXIT evaluation blocks.
freshnessTaxonomy.INTEGRATION_FRESH: No outcomes used in assembling, choosing or tuning any component or interaction of the evaluated stack.
freshnessTaxonomy.SYSTEM_FRESH: No outcomes used by any researcher/agent to design/select/tune either comparison arm, any component, allocation or portfolio rule. All artifacts frozen before release.
freshnessTaxonomy.UNKNOWN: No certification. Never usable as fresh.
freshnessTaxonomy.freshnessIsRelative: Freshness is relative to a hypothesis/frozen stack, access history and claim; it is not a single reusable boolean.
freshnessTaxonomy.exposureTransition: Opening an evaluation consumes freshness for new hypotheses and downstream tuning. It remains evidence for the original one-shot frozen claim only.

reuseResponsibilityClasses.A_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY: Tuning permitted only in a separately authorized stage; never fresh Validation/OOS claims.
reuseResponsibilityClasses.B_VALIDATION_ONLY: One frozen candidate evaluated once; no candidate tuning, no later Development reuse in this program.
reuseResponsibilityClasses.C_COMPONENT_OOS_ONLY: Independent locked component evaluation; no upstream/downstream development reuse.
reuseResponsibilityClasses.D_JOINT_SYSTEM_VALIDATION: One joint frozen-stack run supports Integration + Capital + Portfolio validation simultaneously; these are correlated claims, not three replications.
reuseResponsibilityClasses.E_FINAL_COMPARISON_ONLY: System-fresh paired frozen arms under equal conditions; no tuning or winner-driven refit afterward.
reuseResponsibilityClasses.F_FINAL_PROSPECTIVE_ONLY: Separate chronological forward check after final comparison; no selection, no automatic trading.

budgetDerivation.sessionRule: Retain Entry Validation30; adopt existing Phase57 Validation/OOS30 standard for Entry OOS, EXIT Validation/OOS and final comparison. budgetDerivation.developmentRule: Reuse all76 actually used LONG Development dates, not the unconsumed4 of the original80. Development is in-sample and explicitly non-fresh.
budgetDerivation.exitDevelopmentEventReason: Existing stage2 devATargetIndependentFirstEnter=200 / Checkpoint A. 500/1000/2000 are not imported as minima.
budgetDerivation.interpretation: New prospective adequacy guard for EXIT validation/OOS and joint Integration validation only. +/-10 percentage points is a declared minimum-viable descriptive binary-diagnostic precision choice, not an inherited gate or a P&L/power claim. It never changes Entry Candidate PASS philosophy.
budgetDerivation.dependence: A first Entry per symbol-session is an operational distinct trade opportunity, NOT an IID sample. Same-session/same-symbol correlations remain. Future uncertainty reporting must cluster by session and disclose cross-session dependence.97 does not guarantee a clustered interval width or multiplicity-adjusted precision.
budgetDerivation.jointRequirement: Fixed full session block AND applicable event floor; use all events, never stop early after the97th or200th.
budgetDerivation.shortfallHandling: INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_EVENTS and STOP if event minimum unmet; no extra sessions, threshold relaxation, cherry-picking or performance-based expansion. Fixed sessions do not guarantee events.
budgetDerivation.noGuarantee: This is the minimum viable predeclared design within adopted standard blocks, not a theorem proving statistical sufficiency or a guarantee of a conclusive result.
